new_today_news.headline: Sustainable Aviation Fuel 101: Feedstocks on World Energy
new_today_news.summary: Analysis of SAF feedstock options including HEFA technology using waste-derived feedstocks like used cooking oil and beef tallow. Waste-derived feedstocks are noted to have low carbon intensity due to avoidance of cultivation and land-use emissions, with World Energy prioritizing domestically sourced waste products for reliable supply.

new_today_news.headline: Barrel Energy Inc. Q1 2026 Quarterly Report Filed
new_today_news.summary: Barrel Energy reported Q1 2026 revenue of $42,395 versus $45,144 a year earlier and a net loss of $6,183 compared with prior net income of $16,859. Management disclosed 'substantial doubt' about continuing as a going concern without new funding.
